questions.prompt: With the appearance of electric cars, people wonder whether electric cars can reach the same ___36___ as gasoline cars.
questions.analysis: 36．根据首段“Cars powered by gasoline were sold for many years before cars that use electricity. Car companies are now making cars that are fully powered by electricity only. How do these electric cars measure up to traditional gasoline cars?”（在使用电力的汽车之前，汽油驱动的汽车已经销售了很多年。汽车公司现在生产的汽车完全由电力驱动。这些电动汽车如何与传统的汽油汽车相媲美？）可知。引言是：随着电动汽车的出现，人们想知道电动汽车是否能达到与汽油车相同的标准。因为宾语从句“electric cars can reach the same…as gasoline cars”的主语“cars”是复数名词，空缺处应填名词复数形式standards（标准），故填standards。

questions.analysis: 37．根据第二段首句“Electric and gasoline cars look similar on the outside.”（电动汽车和汽油车外观相似。）可知，相似性：电动汽车和汽油车在外观上看起来很相似。置于句首首字母要大写，空缺处应填不可数名词Similarity“相似性”，故填Similarity。

questions.prompt: Having fewer parts reduces the cost of their maintenance and the ___38___ of having mechanical problems.

questions.prompt: Gas cars can cover a ___39___ distance on a full tank than electric cars on a full charge.

Most gas cars can drive hundreds of miles on a full tank.”（例如，一些电动汽车充满电后只能行驶60至120英里。大多数汽油车加满油后可以行驶数百英里。）可知，与充满电的电动汽车相比，加满油的汽油车可以行驶更长的距离。结合空后比较级的标志“than”，可知空处应填形容词的比较级longer“更长的”，故填longer。

questions.prompt: Your choice depends on your ___40___ .

（八）

（三）

questions.prompt: Water is necessary in every part of our life. We use too much water every day.
questions.analysis: 23．“Water is necessary in every part of our life. We use too much water every day.”表示“水在我们生活的方方面面都是必不可少的。我们每天使用太多的水。”，是“Water in our life生活中的水”的表述，故填Water in our life。

questions.prompt: | | Water and weather | ★Water vapor is ___24___ than any other gas around us.
questions.analysis: 24．根据“Water vapor (水蒸气) is the most important gas (气体) around us.”可知，水蒸气是我们周围最重要的气体，即比其他气体更重要，故填more important。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读填表（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | From water to electricity | ★The moving water ___25___ , so people can make electricity with it.
questions.analysis:
25．根据“Water can run very fast. When it rains heavily, its speed through the air may reach at 20 miles an hour. Because of this, people use moving water to make electricity. For example, people built the Baihetan Hydropower Station (白鹤滩水电站) in Sichuan.”可知，水跑得很快。当它下大雨时，它在空中的速度可能达到每小时20英里。正因为如此，人们使用流动的水来发电。故填runs very fast。
（六）

questions.prompt: Title; Starbucks “Silent Café” | Basic information | The first one in China was ___26___ in Guangzhou.
questions.analysis: 26．根据“Starbucks has opened its first ‘Silent Café’ in China where almost half the staff are hearing impaired.”可知第一个“无声咖啡店”在广州开业，open表示“开业”，此处用被动语态，动词用过去分词。故填opened。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读填表（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Almost half its staff have hearing ___27___ .
questions.analysis: 27．根据“where almost half the staff are hearing impaired.”可知几乎一半的员工都有听力障碍，have后接名词，hearing problems表示“听力障碍”。故填problems。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读填表（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Its customers place their order without having to say anything by writing down certain ___28___ .
questions.analysis: 28．根据“The newly opened ‘Silent Café’ has a special ordering system where all food and drinks are numbered, letting customers easily write down their order and allowing them to place orders without having to say a word.”可知新开的“无声咖啡馆”有一个特殊的点餐系统，所有的食物和饮料都有编号，让顾客很容易写下他们的订单，让他们不用说一句话就可以下单，number表示“号码”，此处用复数。故填numbers。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读填表（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: More hearing-impaired people like me could find their ___29___ career in the future.
questions.analysis: 29．根据“I believe more people like me could find a career they dream about in the future,”可知陈思婷相信更多像她一样的人会在未来找到梦想的职业。此空为形容词作定语修饰名词，ideal表示“理想的”。故填ideal。

questions.prompt: Starbucks could ___30___ disabled people with more opportunities.
questions.analysis: 30．根据“He has hopes that Starbucks could open more opportunities (机遇) for those who are disabled, and encourage them lo prove themselves and to explore more possibilities in life.”可知朱洁莹希望星巴克能够给残疾人提供更多机会，provide sb with sth表示“提供给某人某物”。故填provide。

questions.prompt: Was it easier for the students in Changsha to learn English with VR?
questions.analysis: 4．根据“Recently, a primary school in Changsha, has put Virtual Reality (VR) technology (虚拟现实技术) to good use in an English class. When the students put on the VR glasses, it seemed that they were taken into a new world where they could see for themselves. They could enjoy the views along the way, allowing more knowledge to be kept in mind.”可知，长沙的一所小学在英语课上充分利用了虚拟现实技术，当学生们戴上VR眼镜，他们被带入一个新的世界，他们可以欣赏沿途的风景，同时记住更多的知识。由此可知，VR使学生学习英语变得更容易，此处为肯定回答。故填Yes./Yes, it was.

questions.prompt: Why can the VR help students learn English better?
questions.answer: Because the VR can make students have chances to use English if they are not in English class and make students enjoy learning English quickly.
questions.analysis: 6．根据“Now you are learning English in China, you don’t have enough chances to use English if you are not in English classes, but if you learn English in English-speaking countries like America or the UK, it’ll be much easier for you to make progress.”和“You will learn English so quickly that you will even forget you are learning.”可知，学生在不上英语课时没有足够的机会使用英语，VR让学生在英语课堂之外有机会使用英语，同时学生也能快速地学习英语并乐在其中。故填Because the VR can make students have chances to use English if they are not in English class and make students enjoy learning English quickly.

questions.prompt: Is Sydney the largest city in Australia?
questions.analysis: 8．根据“But in Australia, it is the oldest city. It is also the country’s largest city.”可知悉尼是澳大利亚最大的城市。故填Yes, it is.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How is the climate of Sydney? Give an example.
questions.answer: It’s very good. It’s not too cold during the winter and not too hot during the summer.
questions.analysis: 9．根据“The climate(气候) of Sydney is very good. It’s not too cold during the winter and not too hot during the summer.”可知悉尼天气很好。冬天不太冷，夏天也不太热。故填It’s very good. It’s not too cold during the winter and not too hot during the summer.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How tall is Centrepoint Tower?
questions.analysis: 10．根据“Among them, Centrepoint Tower is the tallest. Standing on the 305-metre(80 storeys) tower, you will have a great view of the city.”可知这个塔305米高。故填It’s 305 meters tall.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is Sydney famous for? Why? Give at least one reason.
questions.answer: Sydney is famous for its deep harbor. Because it has many bays and beautiful surf beaches.
questions.analysis: 11．根据“Sydney is famous for its deep harbor(港口). The harbor has many bays and beautiful surf beaches.”可知悉尼以其深海港而闻名，因为这个港口有许多海湾和美丽的冲浪海滩。故填Sydney is famous for its deep harbor. Because it has many bays and beautiful surf beaches.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do people living in Sydney love to do when they are not working?
questions.answer: They love to have a good time at the beach, go swimming and sailing.
questions.analysis: 12．根据“They are mostly friendly and easygoing. When they are not working, they love to have a good time at the beach, go swimming and sailing.”可知当他们不工作的时候，他们喜欢在海滩上度过美好的时光，去游泳和航海。故填They love to have a good time at the beach, go swimming and sailing.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What are important for teenagers to keep healthy?
questions.answer: Healthy diets, enough sleep time and exercise.
questions.analysis: 13．根据“But they often forget to think about healthy diets, enough sleep time and exercise. In fact, these things are really important for them to keep healthy.”可知，青少年们经常忘记考虑健康的饮食、充足的睡眠时间和锻炼，事实上，这些东西对他们保持健康非常重要，可推测健康的饮食，充足的睡眠和锻炼对青少年保持健康很重要。故填Healthy diets, enough sleep time and exercise.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who need more calories, teenage boys or teenage girls?
questions.analysis: 14．根据“Teenage girls need about 2,200 calories a day while boys need a bit more—doctors suggest 2,800 for teenage boys.”可知，青少年女孩每天需要大约2200卡路里，而男孩需要更多——医生建议青少年男孩需要2800卡路里，可推测青少年男孩需要更多卡路里。故填Teenage boys.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many hours’ sleep do teenagers usually need at night?
questions.analysis: 15．根据“Teenagers usually need eight to ten hours’ sleep at night,”可知，青少年晚上通常需要八到十个小时的睡眠。故填Eight to ten hours.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How often should teenagers exercise?
questions.answer: At least five times a week.
questions.analysis: 16．根据“Experts suggest that teenagers should exercise at least five times a week.”可知，专家建议青少年每周至少锻炼五次。故填At least five times a week.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Can exercise help teenagers to sleep better at night?
questions.analysis: 17．根据“It can even help them to sleep better at night.”可知，它甚至可以帮助他们晚上睡得更好，此处it指代Exercise，them指代teenagers。故填Yes, it can.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why has Row Row Row Your Boat enjoyed a second wave of popularity?
questions.analysis: 18．根据“Row Row Row Your Boat, a traditional English nursery rhyme, which is still popular today, has enjoyed a second wave of popularity because of a Chinese farmer.”可知，流行的原因是因为一位中国农民。故填Because of a Chinese farmer.

questions.prompt: What are netizens amused by?

questions.prompt: Why did Li Huanying come back to China when she was 37?
questions.answer: Because she felt she greatly needed by her country.

questions.prompt: Where did Li Huanying treat the leprosy patients?
questions.analysis: 49．根据“She left her footsteps wherever leprosy patients were in Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan.”可知，在云南、贵州、四川，麻风病患者所到之处，她都留下了自己的足迹。故填In Yunnan, Guizhou and Sichuan.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Did Li Huanying’s efforts of treatment for leprosy patients work out fine?
questions.analysis: 50．根据“Thanks to her efforts, Li shortened the course of treatment(治疗) for leprosy patients to two years. And she cut down the number of leprosy patients from 110,000 to less than 10,000. Li’s treatment method was spread worldwide in 1994.”可知，在她的努力下，李医生将麻风病患者的疗程缩短到了两年。她将麻风病患者的数量从11万减少到不到1万。李的治疗方法于1994年在世界范围内推广。所以李桓英治疗麻风病的努力奏效了，故填Yes.

questions.prompt: What award did Li Huanying receive for leprosy prevention and control in 2016?
questions.answer: She received a lifelong achievement award for leprosy prevention and control in China.

questions.prompt: If you need to write a report, will you type or handwrite it? Why? (Give 2 reasons. )

questions.analysis: 61．开放性试题，言之有理即可。故填I will type it. Because it is very fast and it is easy to correct my mistakes.

questions.prompt: are used in Chinese shadow puppetry. Also, many ______ all mix together in it.

questions.prompt: Shadow puppetry started in the Han Dynasty. One man created a puppet show to ______ the emperor who lost his wife. Then it was ______ spread in the Tang and Qing Dynasties.
questions.analysis: 17．根据“Then he had an idea— he made a puppet (偶) of the emperor’s wife. As night fell, he invited the emperor to watch a puppet show.”可知这个人制作了一个国王妻子的玩偶，让国王来看皮影戏，所以他是为了安慰失去妻子的国王，comfort“安慰”，动词不定式符号to后加动词原形；根据“In the Tang Dynasty, shadow puppetry was played by many people in many places around the country...The art form became the most popular in the Qing Dynasty”可知在唐朝和清朝皮影戏被广泛传播，修饰动词用副词widely“广泛地”。故填comfort；widely。

questions.prompt: Artists join the puppets’ body parts together ______ cutting them separately. In a show, they hold and ______ the puppets with sticks that connect their most important joints.
questions.analysis: 18．根据“Their body parts are cut separately and then joined together”可知它们的身体部位被分开切割后，然后连接在一起，after“在……之后”；根据“In this way, they can hold the puppets and make the puppets walk, run or dance as they want”可知他们可以拿着木偶，让木偶随心所欲地行走、奔跑或跳舞，即控制木偶，control“控制”，此处用动词原形。故填after；control。

questions.prompt: Instead of playing shadow puppetry for a ______ , most puppetry artists in China just play it for fun and love. But this doesn’t ______ becoming experts in this field.
questions.analysis: 19．根据“In fact, most puppetry artists across China don’t get trained and don’t play shadow puppetry as a job”可知中国的大多数木偶艺术家都没有受过训练，也没有把皮影戏当作一份工作，故空一填job；根据“they are still experts (专家）in this field”可知虽然没有经过训练，但是这并没有阻止他们成为专家，prevent them from doing sth.“阻止他们做某事”，助动词doesn’t后加动词原形。故填job；prevent them from。

questions.prompt: Puppetry artists have done a lot to ______ the development of shadow puppetry. The Chinese government also offers them ______ to make the art form great again.
questions.analysis: 20．根据“puppetry artists have explored ways to make this ancient art form as popular as it used to be and pass it on to the young”可知木偶艺术家们探索如何让这种古老的艺术形式像过去一样流行，并将其传递给年轻人，即他们做了很多促进木偶戏的发展，promote“促进”，动词不定式符号to后加动词原形；根据“They also get support from the Chinese government”可知中国政府也给了他们支持。故填promote；support。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之补全句子、补全短文、信息摘录和多任务混合（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: For animals, it is bad news to ______ trees.
questions.analysis: 21．根据“That’s bad news for animals because cutting down trees destroys(破坏) the homes of animals that live in the forests.”可知，这对动物来说是个坏消息，因为砍伐树木破坏了生活在森林里的动物的家园。cut/chop down“砍倒”符合语境，故填cut/chop；down。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之补全句子、补全短文、信息摘录和多任务混合（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Human activities like water pollution and ______ are bringing further losses to the forests.
questions.analysis: 22．根据“What’s worse, some pollutions caused by human activities like water pollution and air pollution are bringing further losses to the forests.”可知，一些由人类活动造成的污染，如水污染和空气污染，正在给森林带来进一步的损失。污染行为有很多，故填air/land/soil/light/nuclear/industrial/waste；pollution。

questions.prompt: campfires before moving on to avoid wildfires in the forest.
questions.analysis: 23．根据“Put out campfires before moving on when you go camping to avoid wildfires in the forest.”可知，当你去露营时，在继续前进之前扑灭营火，以避免森林里的野火。故填Put；out。

questions.prompt: Try to use less disposable ______ to protect more ______ from being cut down.
questions.analysis: 24．根据“Don’t cut down trees for disposable chopsticks(一次性筷子).”可知，不要为了一次性筷子而砍伐树木。除树木外，也不要砍伐森林、竹子等。故填chopsticks；trees/forests/bamboos。

questions.prompt: you get close to nature, please make choices ______ and take the advice above to protect homes for our dearest friends.
questions.analysis: 25．根据“Whenever you have a chance to get close to nature, make wise choices and take the advice mentioned above to protect homes for our dearest friends.”可知，每当你有机会亲近大自然时，做出明智的选择，并采取上述建议，为我们最亲爱的朋友保护家园。故填Whenever/When/If/While/As/Once；wisely/cleverly/smartly/correctly/rightly/carefully。

questions.prompt: Here is some ______ for parents to help their children with reading.
questions.analysis: 26．根据“Forming (养成) the good habit of reading among our kids is really important to their learning success. Parents must do something to help their kids fall in love with reading.”可知文章介绍了给父母帮助他们的孩子阅读的一些建议。结合“is some”可知应用不可数名词advice“建议”。故填advice。

questions.prompt: Parents should provide ______ for their children according to the 2nd paragraph.
questions.analysis: 27．根据“A comfortable place with enough light can help your child read comfortably.”可知父母应该为孩子提供舒适明亮的阅读场所。comfortable and bright“舒适明亮的”；reading places“阅读场所”，复数表示泛指。故填comfortable and bright reading places。

questions.prompt: Parents can ______ with kids if they read to their kids.
questions.analysis: 28．根据“Reading to your kids could really help set up a good relationship.”可知如果父母给孩子读书，他们可以和孩子相处得很好。get on well with sb“和某人相处得好”，情态动词can后加动词原形，故填get on well。

questions.prompt: The fourth paragraph mainly tells parents to ______ to the bookstore.
questions.analysis: 29．根据“A visit to a bookstore once a month is good reading improvement to your kids.”和本段内容可知，第四段主要告诉父母要定期带孩子去书店。take their kids regularly to the bookstore“定期带孩子去书店”。故填take their kids regularly。

questions.analysis: 24．根据“Later that same day Robert looked into his mail box and found a small note there. The note simply said, ‘You did a great job today, Robert.’”可知，演讲结束后，罗伯特在他的邮箱里看到了表扬信。故填his mail box。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word “It” in Paragraph 3 refer to?
questions.analysis: 25．根据“The note simply said, ‘You did a great job today, Robert.’ Robert was very surprised and happy to see the note. It made him feel very confident.”可知，It指的是纸条。故填the note。

questions.prompt: What can we learn from Robert’s story?
questions.answer: the importance of giving praise to other people
questions.analysis: 26．根据“Now as a psychologist, he teaches the importance of giving praise to other people.”可知，我们能从罗伯特的故事中学到赞扬他人的重要性。故填the importance of giving praise to other people。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the writer’s parents always told him when he was a child?
questions.answer: His parents always told him not to talk to strangers.
questions.analysis: 27．根据“When I was a child, my parents always told me that I should never talk to strangers.”可知，当作者还是个孩子的时候，他的父母总是告诉他不要和陌生人说话。故填His parents always told him not to talk to strangers.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How is the weather in Britain?
questions.analysis: 28．根据“The weather in Britain is changeable”可知，英国的天气多变。故填Changeable.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the safest way, if you start a conversation with a French person?
questions.answer: To ask about his or her last holiday.
questions.analysis: 29．根据“To talk with a French person, the safest way is to ask about his or her last holiday.”可知，与法国人交谈，最安全的方式是询问他或她最近的假期。故填To ask about his or her last holiday.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do Americans always ask others where they are from?
questions.answer: Because the US is so big and people move so often.
questions.analysis: 30．根据“The US is so big and people move so often that location is always a source of talk.”可知，是因为美国太大了，人们搬家太频繁了。故填Because the US is so big and people move so often.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does the passage mainly talk about?
questions.answer: Some advice on how to break the ice.
questions.analysis: 31．根据“The following passage offers you some advice on how to break the ice. It will be easier to break the ice if you know more about different cultures.”可知，本文就如何打破与陌生人谈话的僵局给出了一些建议。故填Some advice on how to break the ice.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In which season did the story of Meng Zong happen?
questions.analysis: 32．根据第一段“But it was winter,”可知故事发生在冬季。故填(In) winter.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What could save Meng Zong’s old and sick mother?
questions.analysis: 33．根据第一段“the doctor said that fresh bamboo shoots could save her life.”可知鲜竹笋能救母亲。故填Fresh bamboo shoots.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many examples of filial piety stories were chosen and edited by Guo Jujing?
questions.analysis: 34．根据第二段“This is one story from the Twenty-four Examples of Filial Piety (孝顺) stories.”可知是“二十四孝”的故事。故填24.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In Chinese tradition, one has to completely obey one’s parents, doesn’t he?
questions.analysis: 35．根据第三段“To be a filial son, one has to completely obey one’s parents during their lifetime.”可知按照中国传统，要想成为一个孝顺的儿子，必须在父母的一生中完全服从父母，因此答案是肯定的。故填Yes.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Is the nature of filial piety to love our parents and respect the old, in ancient times or modern times?
questions.analysis: 36．根据最后两句“But the nature of filial piety remains the same. That is to love our parents and respect the old.”可知虽然时代不同，孝顺的方式不同，但是无论现代还是古代，孝顺的本质是一样的。故填Both.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did Tina use to be shy?
questions.answer: Because she was fat and others often laughed at her.
questions.analysis: 37．根据“Tina is my sister, she used to be fat and others often laughed at her, so she became very shy.”可知，蒂娜过去很害羞，因为她很胖，别人经常嘲笑她。故填Because she was fat and others often laughed at her.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who encouraged Tina to change herself?
questions.analysis: 38．根据“But one day, her teacher encouraged Tina to change herself.”可知，她的老师鼓励蒂娜改变自己。故填Her teacher.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long did it take Tina to lose 90 pounds?
questions.analysis: 39．根据“After 6 months, she lost 90 pounds. This taught her that she could change herself.”可知，蒂娜6个月减掉了90磅。故填Six months.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Where did Tina sing aloud in front of many people for the first time?
questions.analysis: 40．根据“A few months later, Tina took part in a singing competition at her school.”可知，蒂娜第一次在许多人面前大声唱歌是在学校。故填At her school.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What did the singing teacher say about Tina?
questions.answer: She said that Tina was talented and her voice was good.
questions.analysis: 41．根据“She said that Tina was talented and her voice was good.”可知，老师说蒂娜很有天赋，声音也很好。故填She said that Tina was talented and her voice was good.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How many children does Galina want to have?
questions.analysis: 42．根据“‘I have one child and she is enough for me,’ said Galina”可知，她有一个孩子，对她来说足够了，也就是说她只想要拥有一个孩子，故填One (child).

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Hana doesn’t want to have any children at all, does she?
questions.analysis: 43．根据“‘I don’t want to have any children until I have worked for at least 10 years,’ said 19-year-old student Hana from Prague.”可知，工作至少10年之前，不想要孩子，并不是根本不想要孩子，故填Yes, she does.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why is the population in Poland going down?
questions.analysis: 44．根据“A lot of people, usually aged between 20 and 30, are leaving the country to work abroad.”及“since then more than half a million people have moved to Britain, Germany, Spain and Italy.”可知，因为许多人，通常年龄在20到30岁之间，正在离开国家到国外工作，超过50万人移居英国、德国、西班牙和意大利，故填Because a lot of people, usually aged between 20 and 30, are leaving the country to work abroad./Because people are leaving to work in other countries./Because more than half a million people have moved to Britain, Germany, Spain and Italy.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How does the French government encourage people to have larger families now?
questions.answer: In France, women receive nearly $1000 a month for a year if they have a third child.
questions.analysis: 45．根据“In France women now receive nearly $1000 a month for a year if they have a third child.”可知，如果生育第三个孩子，妇女每年每月可以获得近1000美元，故填In France, women receive nearly $1000 a month for a year if they have a third child.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What’s the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The population in Europe is going down (falling)./The reasons for the population falling in Europe.
questions.analysis: 46．通读全文可知，介绍了欧洲一些国家人口下降的现状、原因以及政府为此采取的措施，故填The population in Europe is going down (falling)./The reasons for the population falling in Europe.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Is cooking a way to teach kids necessary skills in daily life?
questions.analysis: 47．根据第一段第三句“It’s a way to teach kids necessary skills in daily life.”可知做饭是教给孩子们日常生活中必要技能的一种方式，故填Yes, it is.

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆沙坪坝·重庆八中校考二模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Peter feel about the new ingredient?
questions.analysis: 48．根据第三段中的“Peter, 12, had never eaten broccoli before testing a recipe with broccoli in it. His parents reported that he was so excited about this new ingredient that he cooked it for his family the next night.”可知12岁的Peter在尝试用花椰菜做饭之前从未吃过花椰菜。他的父母报告说，他对这种新食材如此兴奋以至于第二天晚上他为家人做了这道菜，故填He was so excited.

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆沙坪坝·重庆八中校考二模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Please complete the sentence in paragraph 4.
questions.answer: They also help kids develop resilience.
questions.analysis: 49．根据上文“Failures in cooking are as important as the successes, because they help kids to under stand that.”及下文的例子“When Helen, an 11- year- old girl,...Both of them kept trying many times until they managed to make the most delicious cake ever in the end.”可推断此段要阐述的学习做饭的好处是：做饭的失败和成功一样重要，它们也能帮助孩子培养韧性，故填They also help kids develop resilience.

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆沙坪坝·重庆八中校考二模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Will you choose to make some cookies with your family like Tom? Why or why not?
questions.analysis: 50．开放性作答，合理即可。参考答案为Yes, I will. Because it not only teaches us basic skills, but it stimulates creativity, encourages us to think critically and learn to cooperate with each other.

source.sourceSection: （2023·重庆沙坪坝·重庆八中校考二模）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What will you be like if you respect your own decisions according to Paragraph 1?
questions.answer: I will be determined, more creative, more satisfied, and so on.
questions.analysis: 51．根据“Imagine how you will feel if you are able to respect your decisions. You will be determined (坚定的), more creative, more satisfied, and so on.”可知会更坚定、更有创造力、更满意等等。故填I will be determined, more creative, more satisfied, and so on.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What should you do before making a decision according to Paragraph 3?
questions.answer: I should notice how I feel about what I am considering.
questions.analysis: 52．根据“Before making a decision, it is a good idea to notice how you feel about what you are considering.”可知在做出决定之前，最好注意一下你对自己正在考虑的事情的感受。故填I should notice how I feel about what I am considering.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why do others no longer trust you according to Paragraph 4 ?
questions.answer: Because I seldom do what you say.
questions.analysis: 53．根据“If you seldom do what you say, then other people will not trust you, nor will you trust yourself”可知如果你很少说到做到，那么别人不会信任你。故填Because I seldom do what you say.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How could you make wise decisions according to the last paragraph?
questions.answer: By giving importance to your time and energy.
questions.analysis: 54．根据“By giving importance to your time and energy, you will be able to make wise decisions.”可知通过重视你的时间和精力，你将能够做出明智的决定。故填By giving importance to your time and energy.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Give a proper title to the passage.
questions.analysis: 55．本文主要介绍了要尊重自己的决定，这样会变得更坚定、更有创造力、更满意，故文章可以“To respect your decisions”为标题。故填To respect your decisions.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Is Weifang in Shandong province known as the birthplace of kites?
questions.analysis: 56．根据“Weifang in Shandong province has a long history of making kites. It is known as the birthplace of kites.”可知山东潍坊是风筝的诞生地。故填Yes, it is.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What were the kites used for at first?
questions.answer: They were often used by the army for measuring distance and communication purposes.
questions.analysis: 57．根据“At first, they were often used by the army for measuring distance and communication purposes. ”可知起初，它们经常被军队用于测量距离和通信目的。故填They were often used by the army for measuring distance and communication purposes.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When was Weifang kite-making included in the national-level intangible cultural heritage lists?
questions.analysis: 58．根据“Weifang kite-making was included in the national-level intangible cultural heritage (非物质文化遗产) lists in 2006. ”可知潍坊风筝制作于2006年被列入国家级非物质文化遗产名录。故填In 2006.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How long had Yang practiced kite-making skills before she opened her first shop?
questions.analysis: 59．根据“Having a special connection with kites, Yang learned the skills from her grandfather at the age of 16. After she had practiced the skills for 10 years, she started her own shop in 1992.”可知杨在练习了10年之后，她于1992年开了自己的店。故填For ten years.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do you think of Yang’s job? (Give two points.)
questions.analysis: 60．根据“I’m an inheritor of the culture. It is also an important job of mine to spread the heritage around the world and onto the next generation”可知杨的工作是对文化的传承，所以是重要和有意义的。故填It is meaningful and important. /…

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who is Karlsson in this passage?
questions.answer: A Swedish teacher at Beijing Union University.
questions.analysis: 61．根据“Karlsson, a Swedish teacher at Beijing Union University (BUU), has lived in China for over 15 years.”可知他是在北京联合大学的一名瑞典的老师。故填A Swedish teacher at Beijing Union University.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Karlsson learn Chinese in Sweden?
questions.answer: By using textbooks, heavy dictionaries and audio tapes.
questions.analysis: 62．根据“Learning Chinese meant using textbooks, heavy dictionaries and audio tapes. He would read the dictionary carefully for hours to understand a one-page Chinese article.”可知是通过教材，大字典和有声磁带来学习中文。故填By using textbooks, heavy dictionaries and audio tapes.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When did Karlsson start to teach business at BUU?
questions.analysis: 63．根据“In 2008, the year Beijing succeeded in hosting the Summer Olympic Games, he got married. In the next year, he started to teach business at BUU.”可知他2008年结婚，次年在北京联合大学教授商学，即2009年。故填In 2009.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第05讲 任务型阅读之阅读回答问题（阅读表达）（练习）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What has offered Karlsson many chances for personal growth?
questions.answer: Life in Beijing has been a wonderful adventure, especially as a witness to the great achievements China has made.
questions.analysis: 64．根据“Life in Beijing has been a wonderful adventure (异乎寻常的经历), especially as a witness to the great achievements China has made. It has offered him many chances for personal growth.”可知在北京生活的经历，尤其是见证了中国取得的伟大成就给了他成长的机会。故填Life in Beijing has been a wonderful adventure, especially as a witness to the great achievements China has made.

It also brings joy to the lives of the young./Growing vegetables (and fruits) is now more than just away to live. questions.prompt: How many of the 1, 000 British kids from 12 to 16 get only 4 to 7 hours’ sleep a day in the survey?
questions.analysis: 99．根据“The survey was done among 1,000 British kids from 12 to 16. It is found that 50% of them got just 4 to 7 hours’ sleep every day”可知50%的人每天只睡4到7个小时，即500个孩子。故填500/Five hundred (kids).

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what were 25% of the kids doing when they fell asleep?
questions.answer: They were watching TV, listening to music or using other electronic products.
questions.analysis: 100．根据“Almost 25% of the kids said they often fell asleep while they were watching TV, listening to music or using other electronic products.”可知近25%的孩子表示，他们经常在看电视、听音乐或使用其他电子产品时睡着。故填They were watching TV, listening to music or using other electronic products.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does “junk sleep” mean in the passage?
questions.answer: It/“Junk sleep” means you don’t get enough sleep and the quality of the sleep is low, too.
questions.analysis: 101．根据“It means you don’t get enough sleep and the quality (质量) of the sleep is low, too”可知“垃圾睡眠”意味着你睡眠不足，睡眠质量也很低。故填It/“Junk sleep” means you don’t get enough sleep and the quality of the sleep is low, too.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In Dr. Chris’ opinion, what should teenagers do?
questions.answer: They/Teenagers should spend less time on the electronic products./They/Teenagers should keep away from electronic products and spend less time on the electronic products.
questions.analysis: 102．根据“Dr. Chris suggested that parents should help their children keep away from electronic products, and that teenagers should spend less time on the electronic products.”可知他建议青少年应该少花时间在电子产品上，远离电子产品。故填They/Teenagers should spend less time on the electronic products./They/Teenagers should keep away from electronic products and spend less time on the electronic products.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does this passage mainly talk about?
questions.answer: The/This passage/It is (mainly) about “junk sleep”./The/This passage/It (mainly) talks about “junk sleep”./Junk sleep.
questions.analysis: 103．通读全文可知，本文围绕“垃圾睡眠”展开。故填The/This passage/It is (mainly) about “junk sleep”./The/This passage/It (mainly) talks about “junk sleep”./Junk sleep.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 104．根据“Once upon a time, Zeng Zi’s wife was going to the market.”可知，曾子的妻子要去市场，故填Zeng Zi’s wife.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Did the little son go to the market?
questions.analysis: 105．根据“When the son heard what his mum said, he went home happily.”可知，儿子没去市场，故填No.

questions.prompt: Why did the little son go home happily?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Who killed the pig at last, Zeng Zi or his wife?

questions.answer: We must be honest and keep our promises./We shouldn’t cheat others.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题16 任务型阅读 考点2 回答问题（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What does “that” refer to(指的是) in Paragraph Two?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Which sentence in the passage has the similar meaning to the following one?
questions.answer: The elephants were harmful to no one, but had corn and beans on the farm.
questions.analysis: 2．“The elephants didn’t hurt anyone, but only ate some farm plants in the field.”表示“大象没有伤害任何人，但只吃了田间的一些农场植物”，与“The elephants were harmful to no one, but had corn and beans on the farm. ”句意相近，故填The elephants were harmful to no one, but had corn and beans on the farm.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the government create “dining halls” for the wild elephants?
questions.answer: To help protect the interests of farmers, and at the same time avoid the wild animals being hurt by humans.
questions.analysis: 3．根据“Such things will help protect the interests of farmers, and at the same time avoid the wild animals being hurt by humans.”可知，有助于保护农民的利益，同时避免野生动物受到人类的伤害，故填To help protect the interests of farmers, and at the same time avoid the wild animals being hurt by humans.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How did Migmar and his friends save wild animals?
questions.answer: They bandaged the animals and cleaned their wounds, and set them free into the wild when they got well again.
questions.analysis: 4．根据“During this period, they learned to bandage the animals and clean their wounds, and set them free into the wild when they got well again.”可知，给动物包扎伤口，清洗伤口，并在它们康复后把它们放归野外，故填They bandaged the animals and cleaned their wounds, and set them free into the wild when they got well again.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Ask ONE question about one of the following numbers from the passage.
questions.answer: How many wild animals have they saved since the wildlife rescue station was set up?/When was the wildlife rescue station set up? /How much did the villagers lose?
questions.analysis: 5．根据“The villagers lost up to(A)50,000 yuan.”可知，村民损失高达5万元，所以可以询问“村民损失了多少”。根据“The wildlife rescue station was set up in (B) 2019.”可知，2019是野生动物救助站成立的时间，所以可以询问“野生动物救助站是什么时候建立的”。根据“From then on, they have saved (C) 17 wild animals”可知，17是他们救的野生动物的数量，所以可以询问“自从野生动物救助站建立以来，他们已经拯救了多少野生动物”，故填How many wild animals have they saved since the wildlife rescue station was set up?/When was the wildlife rescue station set up? /How much did the villagers lose?

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What do the two examples have in common?
questions.answer: Protecting and taking care of wild animals that appear around us.
questions.analysis: 6．文中列举了两个例子，一个是云南政府采取措施来保护野生动物，另一个是营救者Migmar野生动物救助站来帮助野生动物，所以这两个例子共同点就是保护和照顾出现在我们身边的野生动物，故填Protecting and taking care of wild animals that appear around us.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the Chinese meaning of “characters” in Paragraph Two?
questions.analysis: 7．根据“In ancient times, written Chinese was first symbols and pictures. Then, they gradually became characters. ”可知，它是符号和图画，故填Symbols and pictures.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Why did the writer mention Emperor Qinshihuang in the passage?
questions.answer: Because he set the same standard for the written characters— “small seal” script.
questions.analysis: 8．根据“In the 3rd century BC, the First Emperor, Qinshihuang, set the same standard for the written characters— ‘small seal’ script.”可知，因为他为汉字设定了同样的标准——“小篆书”，故填Because he set the same standard for the written characters— “small seal” script.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Paragraph Two?
questions.answer: The history/development of Chinese characters in ancient times.
questions.analysis: 9．通读第二段可知，本段主要讲述了汉字在古代的历史/发展，故填The history/development of Chinese characters in ancient times.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: 根据短文内容填空。(每空不超过三个单词)
questions.analysis: 10．根据“They turned calligraphy into one of the fine arts, in which calligraphers expressed themselves.”可知，也是表达自己的一种方式，express themselves“表达他们自己”，动词不定式to后接动词原形。根据“In the Tang Dynasty, calligraphy was helpful for a person to get a place in the government.”可知，在唐代，书法有助于一个人在政府中获得一席之地，get a place“获得一个位置”，动词不定式to后接动词原形。根据“Students of calligraphy practiced the main types of script and improved their skills by copying the works of past masters. With the increase of their knowledge and practice, they slowly developed their own styles.”可知，书法学生通过临摹历代大师的作品，练习了主要的字体类型，提高了技巧。随着他们知识和实践的增加，他们慢慢形成了自己的风格，copy“临摹”，by后接动名词，practise and improve“练习和提升”，continue doing sth“继续做某事”。根据“It has become part of the school courses to pass on the Chinese culture.”可知，传承中国文化已经成为学校课程的一部分，make“使，让”，主语是复数形式，动词用原形。故填express themselves；get a place；copying；practising and improving；make。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: 请根据短文内容，分别写出①、②处所缺单词。（每空限填一词）
questions.analysis: 11．根据“He always answers my questions with just a yes or”可知，or后面的应是与yes相反的词，也就是no。根据“I have to spend plenty of time … the answers on my own”可知，花了大量的时间自己去找/获取答案，find“找”，get“得到”，spend time doing sth“花费时间做某事”，故填no；finding/getting。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: 阅读短文，从短文中找出与下面句子意思相近的句子。

questions.answer: 孩子们了解到食物来自哪里
questions.analysis: 74．Kids“孩子们”；learn about“了解到”‘’where food comes from“食物来自哪里”；where they can find it“他们能在哪里发现食物”；and“和”；how important it is in different cultures“食物在不同文化中是如何的重要”。故填“孩子们了解到食物来自哪里，他们能在哪里发现食物，和食物在不同文化中是如何的重要。”

questions.prompt: In the woman’s opinion, the key to happiness is from ______ .

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题18 任务型阅读 考点4 综合任务（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: 请将②处划线句子翻译成中文。
questions.answer: 她也了解到积极的态度创造美好的生活，然而，消极的态度浪费人生
questions.analysis: 79．She “她”；also“也”；learned“了解到”；that引导宾语从句，无实际意义；the active attitude“积极的态度”；creates“创造”；wonderful life“美好的生活”；while“然而”；the negative attitude wastes life“消极的态度浪费人生”。故填：她也了解到积极的态度创造美好的生活，然而，消极的态度浪费人生。

questions.prompt: What do you think of the two girls?
questions.answer: They have active attitude toward life.

If you consider the bread as ice cream, it will be even more delicious.”可知，两个女孩桌子上只有几块干面包、两个冷土豆和一杯水，但是她们靠内心的想象，让简单的食物很美味。所以她们对生活有积极的态度。故填They have active attitude toward life.

questions.analysis: 82．根据“The noise often woke up their babies easily. And the babies really needed a (B) … place to have enough sleep.”和常识可知，婴儿需要在安静的地方睡觉，quiet/peaceful“安静的”，形容词作定语，修饰名词“place”；根据“My family didn’t buy firecrackers this year. (C) …, we gave the money away to a charity.”可知，他们把钱捐了出去，而不是用来买鞭炮，副词instead“相反”符合语境，首字母大写。故填quiet/peaceful；Instead。

questions.prompt: 将(C)处划线句子翻译成英语 ______ .
questions.answer: The/That rich man was deeply moved./The/That rich man was moved deeply.
questions.analysis: 91．由语境可知句子用一般过去时的被动语态，主语是the/that rich man，be动词用was；感动：move，其过去分词为moved；深深地：deeply，可放be动词之后，也可放句尾。故填The/That rich man was deeply moved./The/That rich man was moved deeply.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Foraging is a lot of fun. ___102___
questions.analysis: 102．根据“Some of these plants are dangerous. Some of them are good to eat.”可知搜寻中发现了植物，F项“当你在森林里散步时，你可以发现许多种类的植物”符合语境。故选F。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It is exciting and challenging to find plants that you can eat, but do not eat them until you are very sure of what they are. Before you go foraging, take a class about it. Learn how the different kinds of plants that you can eat look in the wild. Practice finding them with your foraging teacher. Then join a group of foragers. ______ 104 ______ . Never eat anything until you are 100% sure of what it is. Some people have become sick by accident because they ate a wild plant that was dangerous.
questions.analysis: 103．根据“It is exciting and challenging to find plants that you can eat, but do not eat them until you are very sure of what they are.”可知要小心，不能随便吃，E项“虽然搜寻很有趣，但你还是要小心”符合语境。故选E。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Then join a group of foragers.
questions.analysis: 104．根据“Then join a group of foragers.”可知可以加入团队一起搜寻，C项“一起寻找野生植物”符合语境。故选C。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If you take all the plants from one area, no more will grow there. ___105___

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: We should spend at least an hour a day doing sports. ___106___
questions.analysis: 106．根据“We should spend at least an hour a day doing sports.”可知此处介绍了锻炼和运动，E选项“有很多种类的运动”符合语境。故选E。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 107．根据“As young students, we should sleep at least eight hours every night. ”可知此处介绍了良好的睡眠习惯，B选项“有一个好的睡眠习惯”符合语境。故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If we can’t fall asleep soon or aren’t able to have a good sleep, we can lie in a comfortable way, calm down and clear our mind. ___108___

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: This is necessary for the mental health. ___109___
questions.analysis: 109．根据“Smile to ourselves and people around us. ”可知此处引出笑的重要性，A选项“笑是一个好方法”符合语境。故选A。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It encourages us to try again when we fail. ___110___
questions.analysis: 110．根据“Nature can make us less worried and improve our sense of happiness.”可知此处引出自然的重要性，D选项“我们也可以亲近自然”符合语境。故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: But what about your EQ（情商）? ___111___
questions.analysis: 111．根据后句“EQ is a measure of your ability to recognize（辨别）and manage your emotions, as well as the emotions of others, according to Psychology Today.”可知，此处介绍什么是情商，选项B“你知道什么是情商吗？”符合语境，故选B。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: You know yourself very well and you can easily understand others. ___112___
questions.analysis: 112．根据“They are the ability to recognize your own emotions; the ability to use those emotions to solve problems; and the ability to manage emotions”可知，它们是识别自己情绪的能力；运用这些情绪来解决问题的能力；以及管理情绪的能力。此处介绍情商的三种能力，选项D“许多专家将情商分为三种技能。”符合语境，故选D。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Does it seem obvious to you that having a high EQ can be a good thing? ___113___
questions.analysis: 113．根据“They show great social skills, especially when they take up jobs that need them to deal with strangers often.”可知，他们表现出出色的社交技巧，尤其是当他们从事需要经常与陌生人打交道的工作时。此处介绍情商在工作中的情况，选项E“情商高的人在工作中表现得更好。”符合语境，故选E。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: For example, when two friends have an argument, people with a high EQ can ‘read’ the other person’s emotions and know when and how to stop the argument, perhaps by ending it in a humorous way.
questions.analysis: 114．根据“ For example, when two friends have an argument, people with a high EQ can ‘read’ the other person’s emotions and know when and how to stop the argument, perhaps by ending it in a humorous way.”可知，例如，当两个朋友吵架时，高情商的人可以“读懂”对方的情绪，知道何时以及如何停止争吵，也许可以用幽默的方式结束。此处介绍情商在生活中的应用，选项F“拥有高情商对你的日常生活也有帮助。”符合语境，故选F。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题15 任务型阅读 考点1 还原句子（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: If you feel like you have a low EQ, don’t worry. ___115___
questions.analysis: 115．根据“A good way is using positive thinking to help you get out of failures. By doing so, you can improve your EQ gradually.”可知，一个好的方法是用积极的思维来帮助你摆脱失败。通过这样做，你可以逐渐提高你的情商。此处介绍情商是可以提高的，选项A“这是可以提高的。”符合语境，故选A。

questions.prompt: Every summer holiday, the parents would take their son to visit his grandparents. ___116___
questions.analysis: 116．根据“Every summer holiday, the parents would take their son to visit his grandparents.”可知，每年暑假，父母都会带儿子去看望他的爷爷奶奶。此处介绍爷爷奶奶住得地方，选项D“他们住在很远的另一个城市。”符合语境，故选D。

questions.prompt: | | From water to electricity | ★The moving water ___15___ , so people can make electricity with it.
questions.analysis: 15．根据“Water can run very fast. When it rains heavily, its speed through the air may reach at 20 miles an hour. Because of this, people use moving water to make electricity. For example, people built the Baihetan Hydropower Station (白鹤滩水电站) in Sichuan.”可知，水跑得很快。当它下大雨时，它在空中的速度可能达到每小时20英里。正因为如此，人们使用流动的水来发电。故填runs very fast。

questions.prompt: Title; Starbucks “Silent Café” | Basic information | The first one in China was ___16___ in Guangzhou.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Its customers place their order without having to say anything by writing down certain ___18___ .

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | 21 Chinese Clothing | | --- | | Hanfu | In the past | Han people ___22___ Hanfu.
questions.analysis: 22．根据“Hanfu was first created for Han people”可知汉服是汉朝人创造的，create“创造”，句子用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故填created。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | | In recent years | It has been ___23___ more greatly.
questions.analysis: 23．根据“Hanfu has been enjoyed more greatly in recent years.”可知近年来，汉服越来越受到人们的喜爱。故填enjoyed。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Qipao became popular in the 1920s
questions.analysis: 24．根据“Qipao became popular in the 1920s”可知此处介绍的是旗袍。故填Qipao。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Chinese ___25___ wear it when going to important events.
questions.analysis: 25．根据“leaders of China still wear it when going to important events.”可知中国领导人在参加重要活动时仍然穿中山装。故填leaders。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | ChatGPT won’t replace human beings ___26___ , for the following reasons.
questions.analysis: 26．根据“So do you think you’ll replace(替代) some human beings in some areas, such as English teachers, news reporters or people who do customer service work?”和“I don’t think I can replace them completely.”可知，ChatGPT不能完全取代一些人，故填completely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | People can ___27___ several suggestions from ChatGPT and keep learning and improving.
questions.analysis: 27．根据“what advice would you give to human beings in order to be better prepared for the future”和后文内容可知，是人类从ChatGPT那里获得的建议，故填get。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: *Give feedback on ___28___ spoken and written English.
questions.analysis: 28．根据“I can offer advice on grammar and vocabulary, help with pronunciation and provide feedback(反馈) on written or spoken English.”可知，ChatGPT可以提供语法和词汇方面的建议，帮助发音，并提供书面或口语方面的反馈。both...and...符合语境，故填both。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: *Have conversation with people in English to help people improve language skills in a fun and ___29___ way.
questions.analysis: 29．根据“I can take part in conversation with people in English which can help them practice their language skills interestingly and naturally”可知，我可以用英语与人交谈，这可以帮助他们有趣而自然地练习他们的语言技能，此处用形容词natural作定语，故填 natural。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | *ChatGPT can provide useful help, ___30___ it is still a machine.
questions.analysis: 30．根据“Though I can provide useful help in many areas, I am still a machine and there are things only human beings can do.”可知，虽然ChatGPT可以在许多领域提供有用的帮助，但仍然是一台机器，有些事情只有人类才能做。前后构成转折关系，故填but。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: They are ___31___ skills.
questions.analysis: 31．根据“English teaching, news reporting and serving are far more than skills. They are also about feelings, thoughts, cultures and so on.”可知，英语教学、新闻报道和服务远远超过技能。它们也涉及感情、思想、文化等等。beyond“超过”符合语境，故填beyond。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: *Working together with human beings, we can ___32___ better results.
questions.analysis: 32．根据“By working together, better results can be achieved to those we serve.”可知，通过共同努力，我们所服务的对象可以取得更好的成果。achieve“取得”，can后用动词原形。故填achieve。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: That’s to say, don’t copy others’ ideas, have their own thoughts ___33___ .
questions.analysis: 33．根据“First, develop thinking ability. In a word, instead of copying others’ ideas, you should have your own thoughts.”可知，培养思维能力，不要抄袭别人的想法，你应该有自己的想法。instead“反而”符合语境，故填instead。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: *Don’t be afraid of AI and improve their own abilities by ___34___ together with AI.
questions.analysis: 34．根据“Don’t be afraid of AI, it’s important to know how to work together with machines to improve your own abilities.”可知，不要害怕人工智能，重要的是要知道如何与机器合作来提高你自己的能力。by是介词，其后加动名词作宾语。故填working。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: *Develop skills ___35___ creativity and empathy, which only human beings own.
questions.analysis: 35．根据“develop skills only human beings have, like creativity, and empathy(共情)”可知，培养只有人类才有的技能，比如创造力和同理心，此处在举例，like“比如”符合语境，故填like。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | A Food Waste Report | | --- | | | Introduction | Suggestions | | In homes | Some people eat half of the food and throw away ___36___ .
questions.analysis: 36．根据“They throw away the rest of the food.”可知，有些人吃了一半的食物，把剩下的扔掉。the rest或the rest of the food在此处都可以表示“剩下的食物”。故填the rest (of the food)。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | They should plan meals ___37___ .
questions.analysis: 37．根据“So it’s wise for people to plan meals”可知，人们应该明智地计划每一餐，此处修饰动词，应用副词wisely“明智地”，故填wisely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Students should know it’s important to ___38___ and they can play a part in deciding menus.
questions.analysis: 38．根据“And students should be educated to know the importance of saving food.”可知，学校应该知道节约食物的重要性，save food“节约食物”，不定式符号to后用动词原形，故填save food。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Some restaurants order too many ingredients.Restaurants serve customers more than they can eat up.
questions.analysis: 39．根据右栏“Some restaurants order too many ingredients.Restaurants serve customers more than they can eat up.”可知，此处介绍的是在餐馆里的情况，故填In restaurants。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | Food must be properly stored and kept ___40___ .
questions.analysis: 40．根据“food must be properly stored (储存) and kept at the right temperature”可知，食物必须妥善储存，并保持在适当的温度下。故填at the right temperature。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Several successful comedies and novels were ___41___ by her.
questions.analysis: 41．根据“She wrote several successful comedies and novels and was also famous for her translation work.”可知，她写了几部成功的喜剧和小说，空格处为过去分词written，构成被动语态。故填written。

questions.prompt: In 1911, she was born in Beijing.…In 2016, she passed away.
questions.analysis: 42．根据表格右栏中“In 1911, she was born in Beijing.…In 2016, she passed away.”可知，此栏介绍杨绛的经历和生平，experiences“经历”，可数名词，此处为复数，life“生活”，不可数名词。故填experiences/life。

questions.prompt: During 1935-1938, she and her husband were ___43___ to study.
questions.analysis: 43．根据“During 1935—1938, they were abroad to study at Oxford University and University of Paris.”可知，1935至1938年间，她和丈夫出国留学于牛津大学和巴黎大学。abroad“在国外”。故填abroad。

questions.prompt: In 1949, she began to work as a ___44___ at Tsinghua University.
questions.analysis: 44．根据“In 1949, Yang began to teach at Tsinghua University.”可知，1949年，杨开始在清华大学任教。teacher“教师”。故填teacher。

questions.prompt: | | Her work We Three | It is a ___45___ bestseller.
questions.analysis: 45．根据“The book We Three is a national bestseller (畅销书).”可知，《我们仨》一书是全国畅销书，national“国家的”。故填national。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: How to Start the Journey of Volunteering | | --- | | Opinion | ★Volunteering helps people in need, and at the same time it does ___46___ to the volunteers.
questions.analysis: 46．根据“Volunteering not only benefits those in need but also is helpful for the volunteers themselves.”可知，志愿服务不仅有利于那些需要帮助的人，而且对志愿者本身也有帮助。much“许多”符合语境，修饰动词does。故填much。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | The ___47___ for the problem | ★Some people are not ___47___ about their own abilities to be volunteers.
questions.analysis: 47．根据第二段“While it’s true that the more you volunteer, the more benefits you’ll experience making the decision to take the first step can be the biggest challenge. Some people wonder if they will be able to meet the organization’s expectations. Some people fear not knowing anyone else in the group. Not having enough time also prevents some from sharing their abilities.”可知，本段介绍的是问题的原因，reasons“原因”符合语境。故填reasons。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | The ___48___ for the problem | ★Some people are not ___48___ about their own abilities to be volunteers.
questions.analysis: 48．根据“Some people wonder if they will be able to meet the organization’s expectations.”可知，有些人怀疑他们是否能够满足组织的期望。即有些人对自己做志愿者的能力不自信。confident“自信的”，在句中作表语。故填confident。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ★Find a/an ___49___ partner.
questions.analysis: 49．根据“Work with someone who volunteered a lot.”可知，和经常做志愿者的人一起工作。即找到一个有经验的搭档，experienced“有经验的”，在句中作定语。故填experienced。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | Ending | ★Volunteering can make a ___50___ to someone’s life.
questions.analysis: 50．根据“Spend some time on volunteer work and you will see how little things can change a person’s life for the better which makes everyone better person.”可知，花一些时间在志愿者工作上，你会发现小事情可以改变一个人的生活，让每个人都变得更好。make a difference“产生影响”符合语境，故填difference。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | How to be an active listener | | --- | | Importance | Active listening has an ___51___ on your relationships and your work.
questions.analysis: 51．根据“It has an effect on your relationships and your work.”可知，它（积极倾听）会影响你的人际关系和工作。故填effect。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | Suggestions | Wait ___52___ the other person finishes his sentences.
questions.analysis: 52．根据“Wait for a second, so that the other person can finish his sentences.”可知，稍等一下，好让对方把话说完。也就是等待直到对方把话说完，用until引导时间状语从句。故填until。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Listen with your eyes, ___53___ and ears.
questions.analysis: 53．根据“Make sure that you listen with your eyes, heart and ears.”可知，确保你用你的眼睛、心和耳朵去倾听。故填heart。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Show that you are ___54___ in what he is saying.
questions.analysis: 54．根据“To be an active listener, you can also show your interest in what he is saying, and you want to know more.”可知，要成为一个积极的倾听者，你也可以表现出你对他所说的话感兴趣，你想知道更多。be interested in“对……感兴趣”，故填interested。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: | | Active listening can help you truly ___55___ each other.
questions.analysis: 55．根据“Active listening can help you truly understand what people are saying in conversations.”可知，积极倾听可以帮助你真正理解人们在谈话中所说的话。know“了解”符合语境，故填know。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Keep healthy. Eat plenty of fruit and vegetables, drink lots of water, and avoid too much red meat. Take exercise to improve your mood and outlook. Go running, get down to the gym, or take a walk through nature.
questions.analysis: 51．根据“Keep healthy. Eat plenty of fruit and vegetables, drink lots of water, and avoid too much red meat. Take exercise to improve your mood and outlook. Go running, get down to the gym, or take a walk through nature.”可知保持健康需要吃得健康和锻炼，take exercise“锻炼”。故填exercise。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 52．根据“Start each day by focusing on what to do, then make a list for that day”可知每天从专注于该做什么开始，然后列出当天的清单。make a list“列清单”。故填list。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 53．根据“If so, please read our list of things to increase the quality of your life.”可知保持健康和制作日常计划都是提高你的生活质量的方法。suggestions to increase the quality of your life“提高你生活质量的建议”，故填increase。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 54．根据“Learn a skill. It is one of the most satisfying things you can do. A great way to learn a skill is to join a class.”可知学习一项技能的好方法是参加一个班。故填Learn a skill。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.analysis:
55．根据“Help others. Helping others is helping yourself. Not only do you feel good about yourself, but other people will benefit from your kindness.”可知帮助别人就是帮助自己，你不仅自我感觉良好，其他人也会从你的善良中受益。题干中已有from，此处应用your kindness。故填your kindness。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Slat first suggested cleaning up millions of tons of ______ to stop ______ the ocean.
questions.analysis: 66．根据“Boyan Slat heard this over and over when he first suggested a way to clean up millions of tons of plastic polluting our oceans.”可知，博扬·斯莱特第一次提出一种清理海洋的数百万吨塑料来阻止污染海洋。“塑料”可用plastic或plastics来表示，动词短语stop doing sth意为“阻止做某事”，“污染”是动词pollute，其动名词为polluting。故填plastic/plastics；polluting。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Slat was diving in Greece, he found there were ______ fishes ______ plastic bags.
questions.analysis: 67．根据“Slat was on a diving（潜水）trip in Greece three years ago when he was troubled by plastic. ‘There were more plastic bags than fishes,’ he says.”可知，三年前，斯莱特在希腊潜水时，受到了塑料的困扰。“塑料袋比鱼还多，”他说。说明鱼比塑料少，应用fewer…than表示“比……更少”。故填fewer；than。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: “Fishing” up the plastic might need a ______ time and ______ too much.
questions.analysis: 68．根据“Most people wanted to ‘fish’ up the plastic using ships with nets—which might need more than 1,000 years, cost too much, and leave sea life along with the rubbish.”可知，大多数人想用带网的船来“打捞”塑料，这可能需要1000多年的时间，成本太高，并留下海洋生物和垃圾。说明“打捞”塑料可能需要很长时间，而且成本太高。应用形容词long“长的”修饰名词time，情态动词might后接动词原形，因此应用动词cost的原形来表示“花费（金钱）”。故填long；cost。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Slat hoped the rubbish would be pushed to the tube by ______ and ______ .
questions.analysis: 69．根据“Wind and waves will push the rubbish to the tube.”可知，风和浪会把垃圾推到管子里。故填wind/waves；waves/wind。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It will ______ Slat and his team over three to four years to test ______ his project is good enough or not.
questions.analysis: 70．根据“Over the next three to four years, Slat will continue to test whether his project is good enough or not.”可知，在接下来的三到四年里，斯莱特将继续测试他的项目是否足够好。根据“It will”可知此处应用动词原形take来表示“花费（时间）”，根据“or not”可知第二空应填入whether。故填take；whether。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Jenny enjoyed dancing very much, so when she had to begin ______ that evening while her friends were getting ready to go to the dance.
questions.analysis: 71．根据“she enjoyed dancing very much, so when she had to start working that evening while her friends were getting ready to go to the dance, she felt very sorry for herself. ”可知珍妮非常喜欢跳舞，所以当她不得不在那天晚上开始工作，而她的朋友们正准备去参加舞会时，她为自己感到非常难过。work“工作”，begin to do“开始做”，为固定短语。故填to；work。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 任务型阅读 考点3 完成句子或表格（第02期）-学易金卷：2023年中考英语真题分项汇编（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Jenny went to each sick child ______ another and said goodnight.
questions.analysis: 72．根据“She went to each sick child one by one and said good night. ”可知珍妮一个接一个地去看望每个生病的孩子，并说晚安。one by one=one after another“一个接一个”。故填one；after。

questions.prompt: Jenny came to a little boy called Tommy.
questions.analysis: 73．根据“She came to a little boy called Tommy in the end.”可知最后她走到一个叫汤米的小男孩旁。in the end=at last“最后”。故填At；last。

questions.prompt: Poor Tommy had a very serious illness, and now he was ______ hardly move any part of his body except his hands.
questions.analysis: 74．根据“Poor Tommy had a very serious illness, and now he could hardly move any part of his body except his hands.”可知可怜的汤米得了一场非常严重的病，现在除了双手，他几乎不能移动身体的任何部分。could=was able to表示“能够”。故填able；to。

questions.prompt: Too much CO2 causes atmosphere to keep in too much ___33___ .

questions.prompt: What were the two products that Sandra created? Why could she create them?
questions.analysis: 18．根据“She loves to build with Legos（乐高）, so she decided to build lego creations based on the stories of Greek mythology characters. She’s also really good at art, so she created a book about her favorite characters. In her book, she drew pictures of them and wrote the stories in her own words.”可知，她喜欢用乐高积木，所以她决定根据希腊神话人物的故事制作乐高积木。她也很擅长艺术，所以她创作了一本关于她最喜欢的人物的书。在她的书中，她画了他们的照片，并用自己的话写了故事。故填She created Lego creations and a book./She created them based on her talents and skills./Because she loves to build with Legos and she is good at art./Because of her talents and skills./Because she loves Legos and art.

From Shy Girl to Pop Star

For this month’s Young World magazine, I interviewed 19-year-old Asian pop star Candy Wang. Candy told me that she used to be really shy and took up singing to deal with her shyness. As she got better, she dared to sing in front of her class, and then for the whole school. Now she’s not shy anymore and loves singing in front of crowds.

I asked Candy how life was different after she became famous. She explained that there are many good things, like being able to travel and meet new people all the time. “I didn’t use to be popular in school, but now I get tons of attention everywhere I go.” how ever, too much attention can also be a bad thing. “I always have to worry about how I appear to others and I have to be very careful about what I say or do. And I don’t have much private time anymore. Hanging out with friends is almost impossible for me now because there are always guards around me.”

What does Candy have to say to all those young people who want to become famous? “Well,” she begins slowly, “you have to be prepared to give up your normal life. You can never imagine how difficult the road to success is. Many times I thought about giving up, but I fought on. You really require a lot of talent and hard work to succeed. Only a very small number of people make it to the top.

Stories and Art of Chinese Fans
You may think you cannot live through summer without air conditioners. But in ancient China, hand fans were almost the only ones to help people keep cool.

Chinese people started to use hand fans over 2,000 years ago. The fans came in different shapes, such as round and square. They were also made from all kinds of materials. Palm(芭蕉) leaf fans were cheap and easy to make. Feather fans showed the owner’s high status. Sandalwood(檀香) fans could send out a sweet smell.
Later, hand fans became far more than just something that could cool you down. They developed into art works, in which tuanshan (round fans) and sheshan (folded fans) were the most common

In the shape of full moon, tuanshan were usually made of silk. They had beautiful birds and flowers on them. Women especially those in the imperial palace liked to use them. Meanwhile, men, especially the literati,used zheshan. The literati liked them because zheshan were usually made of paper and they could paint and write poems on them. It was a way for them to show off their ability in literature, painting and handwriting. Almost anything can be painted on zheshan.
Today, Chinese people still use these fans, only not many people write or paint on them any more. Next time when you are waving a fan, you may think of the stories behind it.

I am Nancy Smith, a student of Grade Eight. I was born in America. My mother is American and my father is Chinese. Although I live in New York, I like listening to Chinese stories which my father often tells me. The ancient Chinese stories are so amazing that I often think they are not real. Sometimes my father takes my mother and me to the places of interest when he goes to his hometown in China. We often lose ourselves in the wonderful scenery. My father’s relatives are very friendly to us. I get on well with them. Also, I enjoying wearing Han traditional clothes, which makes me look cool. My friends around me are interested in the special and beautiful clothes. Besides, I am attracted (吸引) by Chinese poems, especially Tang poems. Whenever my father teaches me poems, I can imagine a picture in my mind. I often read Chinese poems and I have a special Chinese name, Li Bai. Because Li Bai is my favorite Chinese poet and I like his poems very much. Since I studied Tang poems when I was very young, I have learned about forty poems now. Here’s one poem that both my father and I like most. My father taught me five years ago. And he often reads the poem during Chinese traditional festivals. Now I share it with you.

rows: Homesickness in a Silent Night Before my bed the silver moonbeams spread, I wonder if it is the frost (霜) upon the ground, I see the moon so bright when raising my head, Withdrawing my eyes my nostalgia (乡愁) comes around.

Last week, we went on a school trip to the Singapore Botanic Gardens（新加坡植物园）. We went there by bus. We talked happily while enjoying the beautiful sceneries along the way.

It took us three hours to get there. As soon as I got off the bus, I was surprised to find the beauty of the vegetation（植物）. There was beyond our wildest dreams! As we stepped into the “Amazon Forest”（微风） blowing toward us.

After a long walk, we went into the Orchid Garden（兰花园）. The moment I laid my eyes on the flowers there, I let out an excited cry. From blue orchids to yellow orchids, red orchids to orange orchids, I saw a spectacular site（壮观景象）! I feasted my eyes on（饱览） the beautiful flowers.

Just then, it started to rain. Luckily, we were near the Sembcorp Cool House（胜科冷室）. We ran as fast as our tired legs could carry us to the cool house. The moment we entered, we felt the nice welcoming air-conditioning（空调）. There we saw plants that can only grow in cooler temperatures. There were over 1,000 orchid types to see!

In Singapore, if famous people visit, we will name an orchid after them, to remember their visit. Our national flower, the Vanda Miss Joaquim（胡姬花）, is also an orchid. This shows that orchids are important flowers in our country!
I had a wonderful day at the Singapore Botanic Gardens. It has become my favorite place. Whenever you think you need your mood（心情） lifted, the Singapore Botanic Gardens is the place for you!
As seen from the world map, Singapore is just a little red dot（点）. However, there are amazing wonders that live on the land. Welcome to Sigapore to find more!

Sand storms are among nature’s most terrible phenomena(现象). High winds lift dirt or sand particles into the air, causing air pollution, property damages, injuries, and deaths. No matter where you are, it’s a good idea to know what to do. Here are some ways to protect you if you see a wall of sand racing toward you.

Put a mask over your nose and mouth. If you have a mask, put it on at once. If you don’t have a mask, wrap a piece of cloth around your nose and mouth. Try to make it a bit wet if you have enough water.

Protect your eyes. Wearing goggles (护目镜) is a good way to offer protection for your eyes. If you don’t have goggles, protect your face with your arm as you move. Then wrap a piece of cloth tightly around your head to protect your eyes and ears.

Keep yourself from flying objects. Cover as much of your body as possible to protect yourself from the sand. The sand can hurt, but a sand storm’s high winds can also carry heavier (more dangerous) objects. If you find yourself without protection, try to stay low to the ground and protect your head in a rapid way with your arms, a backpack or a pillow.

Wait out the storm. Don’t try to move through the storm, which is much too dangerous. Stay where you are and wait for it to pass before you try to move to a different place. If you can quickly reach your home before a sand storm reaches you, get there as quickly as possible and stay inside. Close all the windows and doors, and wait out the storm.

In addition, when you are suffering from the sand storm, you should make an effort to stay low to ground and use your arm, a backpack or a pillow to protect your head ___49___ . Last but not the least, remember to wait out the storm. That is to say, it is ___50___ to move through the storm. Before a sand storm reaches you, reach your home as quickly as you can.

There is a traditional toy called taiping nijiaojiao. It is a clay toy and also a whistle (哨子) in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu. It has a history of over 1,000 years.

Taiping nijiaojiao is made of the mud (泥) from the local mountain. It takes more than ten steps to make the clay toy, and the key step is to knead (捏) it with your hands. You can knead the clay toy into anything, like animals and plants. The blowhole is the most difficult part to make, for the size of the blowhole makes a difference to the sound. While coloring, you can use traditional cultural elements (元素) that carry good meanings. It’s hard to make taiping nijiaojiao. But when you finally make it, you will feel proud of yourself.

Zhou Baokang, a lover of folk art, learned how to make the clay toy from local artists about 20 years ago. He wants more people to know about it, so he has opened a museum to introduce the clay toy. He teaches kids how to make the clay toy, too.
There are many traditional art forms in China, but some of them have been lost. Luckily, the traditional clay toy taiping nijiaojiao is kept to this day.

阅读下面短文， 根据短文内容，在每小题句子空白处填入适当词语，使其意思与短文内容一致（每空词数不限）。

Long ago, there was a man called Sessa. He invented a new game to make his friend, the king, happy. He called it “chess”. The king loved it and decided to give him anything he liked. However, Sessa told the king he only wanted some grains of wheat（小麦粒）.
“What?!” said the king, greatly surprised.

“Since you enjoy my chessboard so much, just give me a grain of wheat on the first square（方格）of the chessboard, two grains on the second square, four for the third, and so on. Each square doubles the last,” replied Sessa.
“Very well!” the king told his prime minister（大臣）, “give it to him!”
The first day, when the prime minister gave Sessa a grain of wheat, everyone laughed loudly.
The second day, he got two. The ninth day, Sessa received 256 grains. It took Sessa 16 days to get enough wheat to fill a large bag, but only one more day to get two bags.
By the end of the month, wagons（马车）filled with grains were moving into Sessa’s house. The prime minister was very worried and went to see the king.
“Dear king! Sessa has now collected nearly all our wheat! If we continue, our wheat will soon be empty!” he said.
“Impossible!” said the king. But after he checked and double-checked, he found that by the 64th square, he should give Sessa a total of 18, 446, 744, 073, 709, 551, 615 grains of wheat!
The king had to call Sessa and take back his words.
Sessa replied, “I am happy with what I have now-I won't ask you for the second half of the chessboard. ”
With that, the king and Sessa were still best friends and Sessa got what he wanted—a wiser king.

Crying brings advantages to both your body and mind. It is a good way to make you feel less stressed and cheer you up. It also helps keep your eyes clean. Crying is like giving your eyes a good wash from the inside. Moreover, it can help you sleep better.

Crying is usually connected with emotions like anger or sadness. When you are happy, you may not often think of crying. But have you ever heard of “happy crying”? You might have experienced it before. Scientists have found out happy crying may happen in the following situations:
☆When you have feelings that can’t be expressed

When you have some bad feelings that haven’t been noticed for a long time, and they are not allowed to be expressed, happy crying happens. That is to say, even when you experience something happy, the bad feelings that haven’t been noticed or dealt with will still make you cry.
☆When you are unable to keep yourself in good condition

Crying can help you manage strong moods or feelings. Some happy moments can also bring you strong feelings and you may find it hard to control them, so crying can be of help. When you cry, it feels like you are driving some bad or terrible feelings away from your body. Besides, the hormones (激素) in tears can help to keep a balance between body and mood. They can calm you down and make you feel peaceful.

The science and technology backyard program was started by China Agricultural University in Beijing. This program sends students to help solve practical (实际的) farming problems. Hou Yulin, 25, studies at this university. He has taken part in the program. On a recent afternoon, he went to a green field. He walked around to spread fertilizer (肥料) over crops (庄稼) together with several farmers in Handan, Hebei.

Under the program, students do research in fields and use their knowledge to help farmers. On May 3rd, Chinese President Xi Jinping replied to a letter from students taking part in the program. Xi Jinping praised (C) them for their work on the front line of farming. Zhang Fusuo, a professor (教授) at China Agricultural University, started the first science and technology backyard project in 2009 in Hebei province.

His idea is simple. “The farmers don’t understand our research. We need to find a way to go down to the countryside. (A) That will make technology truly useful in solving practical problems,” Zhang said. His wish has come true. Take Hou for example, Hou studies resource utilization (资源利用) and plant protection to help improve crop output (产量).

So far, the university has developed 139 science and technology backyard projects in 24 provincial-level (省级) areas in China. (B) Another 780 such projects will be set up across the country in the future. The program has also been introduced in eight countries in Africa.

An ant is walking by the river. He looks at the river and says to himself, “How nice and cool this water looks! I must drink some of it.” But when he is drinking, he falls into the river.
“Oh. Help! Help!” the ant cries.
A dove（鸽子）is sitting in the tree. She hears him and offers him a leaf, “Climb up that leaf,” she says, “and you will get to the bank（河岸）.” The ant follows the advice, and he is saved.

“Thank you, Dove. You’re so kind. You have saved my life, and I wish I could do something for you. Goodbye!” the ant says and runs home. “Goodbye!” says the dove, “Be careful not to fall into the river again.”
After a few days, the dove is building her nest（巢）. And a man is raising his gun to shoot at her.
The ant sees this, and runs fast to bite the man’s leg. “Ouch! Ouch!” The man feels a terrible pain and drops his gun. The dove flies away quickly. So the man picks up his gun and leaves.
The dove comes to the ant and says gratefully, “Thank you, my little friend. You have saved my life.” 小蚂蚁十分高兴，因为他能帮助鸽子。
